verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repository (nottelabs/notte) describes the product's agent and scripting framework, which suggests at least part of the source is readable. Nothing in the pack names a license or says which parts of the platform are open versus proprietary cloud services. One community commenter implies the product is not open source, but that is an open question rather than a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence and does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), clarity on whether the cloud infrastructure, CLI and MCP server are also open, and first-party docs or independent confirmation of open-source status.
